name: BSP_AirOps_SlotTick
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(slot, float step). The per-slot tick and the only writer of state 5 in the image (006C058F). 006C051A accumulates slot+30h; 006C0527 raises the timer to at least 5.0 (00CE3850) and clears slot+34h when that byte is set, so the byte means do-not-wait; 006C0549 splits on slot+28h, mirroring entity+3CCh into slot+8h when a squadron is out, and otherwise, in states 3 or 4 only, zeroing slot+8h before 006BD3F0 runs and taking min(block+58h - committed, 006BF230.available, slot+0Ch) into state 5. No compare against the timer exists in the routine. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_UpdateSlots
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, float step). Walks block+4Ch by index for block+50h slots calling 006C0510 at 006C0DFB, and for each slot the tick returned true for builds 006BD520's message and routes it through 0077C7B0. Sub-update 2 of 006CDC70. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_QueuedSlotWait
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block). Sub-update 4 of 006CDC70. Takes the head of the list at block+14h/+18h, whose node+8h is a slot index, and when that slot is in state 2 AND slot+30h is above DAT_00D7A24C (00 00 80 3F, 1.0) AND block+38h is zero AND 006BED60 answers, calls 006BC8E0 with the slot index and then 0048CD50. This is the only compare against slot+30h this packet found, which is what shows the 5.0 at 00CE3850 to be a state-entry preload rather than a countdown target. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_PullReadyPlane
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block). THE WRITER OF block+38h, at 006C6589, which docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_START.md listed as missing. Runs only while block+38h is zero and the list at block+D8h is not empty; takes the head node's payload at node+8h, operates on the container at block+C0h through 006C4A70, moves the observer pair at block+24h off the old entity (006952A0) onto the new one (00694A60) with the observed slot at [block+24h]+14h, and enables its scene node through 00922F30. So block+38h is the entity the deck has pulled out of its queue and is holding, which is what 006BF620, 006CC690 and 006C5050 all refuse on. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_ReleaseSquadronSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, squadron). Finds the slot whose +28h is the squadron, unregisters the observer, clears +28h and +8h, and leaves the slot in state 1 with the 5.0 second timer from 00CE3850. This is what a landing does to an air base; nothing is returned to the stock list. docs/AIR_OPERATIONS.md (packet cc2_air_operations).

name: BSP_AirOps_AddStock
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, VehicleClass*, int count) RET 8. Finds the stock list node at block+40h whose payload +0h matches the class and adds to its count at +4h (006CA847), or pushes back a new payload {class, count, 5} (006CA7E8-006CA7FB). Then replicates through 006BD9E0/0077C7B0 and notifies 00984EB0 with the per-category total from 006BF100. The producer of AddAirBaseStock and AddAirBasePlanes at 00896C54. docs/AIR_OPERATIONS.md (packet cc2_air_operations).

name: BSP_AirOps_LoadFromScene

name: BSP_AirOps_PushReadyPlane
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, entity). The filler of the queue 006C6540 drains, and so the other half of the deck's own brake. 006CC767 takes LEA ESI,[ECX+0C0h], which is where the container starts; block+D8h is its head pointer and block+DCh its count, which is why a store census of both offsets is empty. Registers an observer pair on the entity through 00694A60, splices a node carrying it through 006BFBD0 and links it in. One caller, 007F1C57 in 007F1C00. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_PushReadyPlaneAlternate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, entity). Byte for byte the same push as 006CC760 onto a DIFFERENT list: block+74h rather than the block+C0h container whose head is block+D8h. 007F1C00 chooses between the two on *(00E188A8 + 1FE4h), taking 006CC760 when it is non-zero and this when it is zero; that is the same game-state word 006CDC70 gates its sub-updates on against 2. What distinguishes the two lists was not established. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_SlotCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, slot, order, arg, owner_player, apply). The live copy of the slot-state dispatch that 006CD350 inlines behind a state-5 guard, which is why 006CD350's 1/2/3 arms are unreachable: 006CD39B already required state 5 and 006CD3CA re-reads the same dword. Dispatches on slot+2Ch for 5, 1, 2, 3 and 4; writes state 1 at 006CCE3A, state 4 at 006CCF9D after issuing the recall through the squadron's vtable+114h and a command to the owner at block+7Ch, and state 3 at 006CD0EC. docs/AIROPS_LAUNCH_TICK.md (packet cc8_airops_launch_tick).

name: BSP_AirOps_UpdateSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(block, int slot, class, count, equipment). Only the state-5 branch 006CD3A8-006CD434 was read: launch count is min(block+58h - 006BD3F0, 006BF330(class), slot+0Ch), the slot leaves state 5 for state 1 with timer 0 or 5.0, and a positive count reaches 006BC6F0. Branches from 006CD43C are unread, so the name covers the routine but the reconstruction is a partial projection. docs/AIR_OPERATIONS.md (packet cc2_air_operations).

name: BSP_AirOps_Update

name: BSP_AirOpsSite_SetReadyPlaneObserver
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_airfield_taxi, read-only analysis. __thiscall(site, entity* target), RET 4, Ghidra body 006CF190-006CF1BD, complete. name: BSP_AirOpsSite_GetAirFieldBlock

name: BSP_AirOpsSite_TaxiTargetPoint
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_airfield_taxi, read-only analysis. __thiscall(site, vec3* out, unit* plane), RET 8, Ghidra body 006CF420-006CF517, complete. Slot +2Ch of the airfield launch-site vtable 00CF89F8. Calls 006D2640 on site+44h to pick a hangar exit path; takes its LAST point index ((path+0Ch - path+8h)>>2 - 1), samples 007AF800 BSP_ScenePath_TransformPointToWorld and transforms the result into the airfield's local frame through the cached inverse at airfield+110h. With no usable hangar it returns the plane's own world position at plane+0FCh, which makes the taxi delta zero. This is the point the state-5 Runway on Path bot steers at every step (009CD540 at 009CD5FF, 009B22C0 at 009B238E). docs/AIRFIELD_TAXI.md

name: BSP_AirOpsSite_SpotIsClear

name: BSP_AirOpsSite_PlacePlaneOnSpot
